title: What's new in {{version}}
intro: A few changes worth knowing about:
items: Fixed character spells showing dashes instead of real data (casting time, range, components) in the spellbook.
Fixed deleting a spell from the Known tab — it's now actually removed from the character instead of reappearing.
Paladin and Ranger now get suggested spells during character creation.
Unified the Cleric class translation in the spellbook.
Fixed Ukrainian-language spell search on the character sheet.
Adding an existing spell from the spellbook on the character sheet no longer creates a duplicate.
The filters block and the local-storage banner in the spellbook can now be collapsed/closed.
